rubric.1: supplies some requested facts but misses others
rubric.0: supplies none of the requested facts; topic or numeric coincidence is insufficient

method: Author reviewed all 60 question/reference meanings as a shared intent matrix; parallel language forms inherit those judgments.
checks: Specific people, objects, numbers, conditions and actions distinguish the information needs.
Photosynthesis and producer classification share a topic but do not answer each other’s requested fact.
Area and perimeter both yield sixteen in different examples; the other shape/calculation does not answer the question.
Different bank identifiers, document purposes, policy actions and deadlines are not interchangeable answers.
